# Lifeway Rehabilitation and Child Development Centre
> Comprehensive rehabilitation and child development services in Perinthalmanna, Kerala.

## Overview
Lifeway Rehabilitation and Child Development Centre provides holistic, multidisciplinary care for adults and children. Services include Neuro Rehabilitation, Paediatric Rehabilitation, Ortho Rehabilitation, Geriatric Rehabilitation, Women's Health, Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Speech Therapy, Clinical Psychology, and Special Education.
